Class BKKCKCF

java.lang.Object
org.openscience.cdk.smsd.algorithm.mcsplus.BKKCKCF
@Deprecated public class BKKCKCF extends Object
Deprecated.
SMSD has been deprecated from the CDK with a newer, more recent version of SMSD is available at http://github.com/asad/smsd.
This class implements Bron-Kerbosch clique detection algorithm as it is described in [F. Cazals, vertexOfCurrentClique. Karande: An Algorithm for reporting maximal c-cliques; processedVertex.Comp. Sc. (2005); vol 349; pp. 484-490] BronKerboschCazalsKarandeKochCliqueFinder.java
Author:
Syed Asad Rahman <asad@ebi.ac.uk>
